name: Aa.ishah radhi-yAllaahu anhaa related that...
arabic: ((جَعَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ يُدْخِلُ يَدَيْهِ فِي الْمَاءِ فَيَمْسَحُ بِهِمَا وَجْهَهُ، وَيَقُولُ: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ إِنَّ لِلْمَوْتِ سَكَرَاتٍ)).

transliterations.latin: La ilahe il-laAll-llahu inne lil mevti le sekeratin

translations.albanian: Nuk ka hyjni që meriton të adhurohet përveç Allahut, vërtet vdekja ka agonitë e saja.
translations.english: 'Aa.ishah (radhi-yAllaahu 'anhaa) related that The Prophet (sal-Allaahu 'alayhe wa sallam) [during his illness in which he passed away] would dip his hands in water and then he would wipe his face and say: ‘None has the right to be worshipped except Allaah, death does indeed contain agony.’
translations.indonesian: Membaca dzikir tertentu yang sudah diterangkan dalam hadits dan membaca Al-Qur'an 162 Apabila Tertimpa Sesuatu Yang Tidak DIsenangi
